item.description: In an effort to push its PC gaming ambitions further, Microsoft have announced that they are introducing Postgame Recaps to the Xbox app on PC. The post Microsoft announces new ‘Postgame Recaps’ for Xbox PC titles first appeared on KitGuru.

item.title: Pokémon Leaf Green and Fire Red are officially coming to Nintendo Switch
item.description: It's official, Nintendo and Game Freak are finally bringing back Pokémon Leaf Green and Fire Red. However, unlike the majority of other classic game re-releases on the Switch, these titles will not be part of the Switch Online virtual console system and will instead be sold as standalone games on the eShop. The post Pokémon Leaf Green and Fire Red are officially coming to Nintendo Switch first appeared on KitGuru.

item.title: PCSpecialist responds to our Element Elite R article
item.description: Yesterday we published an article and accompanying video, detailing the Element Elite R prebuilt PC that we were sent by PCSpecialist. We demonstrated how the system had been built improperly, resulting in the PCIe riser cable completely blocking one of the two AIO cooler fans. We reached out to PCSpecialist with our findings and questions and have today received a full response... The post PCSpecialist responds to our Element Elite R article first appeared on KitGuru.

item.title: Thermal Grizzly now sells delidded Ryzen 9850X3D backed by warranty
item.description: Back in early 2025, Thermal Grizzly officially began selling delidded processors, backed by a warranty to give PC builders peace of mind. item.title: Capcom speaks out on Resident Evil Requiem leaks
item.description: A few days ago, we learned that physical copies of Resident Evil Requiem had leaked, close to two weeks before the game's planned release. As a result, footage of the game's ending, amongst other spoilers, have begun landing on social media and forums. The footage won't last long though, as Capcom is keeping a watchful eye out. The post Capcom speaks out on Resident Evil Requiem leaks first appeared on KitGuru.
